text:
rachel_sales: NimbusCommerce POC blocked - Okta SCIM returns 400 when pushing users. Demo Friday morning.
oli_se: Any Okta log snippet?
rachel_sales: They sent: `400 Bad Request - \"payload validation failed: unknown attribute 'officeLocation'\"` They say Okta's app mapping includes officeLocation.
ben_infra: We normally ignore unknown attributes. Did we enable strict SCIM validation on that tenant? tenant=nimbus-poc-9
mai_sec: We had a brief security sweep and flipped strict validation for a few POCs last week.
ben_infra: Confirmed: scim.strictValidation=true for nimbus-poc-9. I'll flip to false for the POC and log the change.
deploy-bot: config update: tenant=nimbus-poc-9 key=scim.strictValidation old=true new=false by ben_infra at 2026-03-21T13:14:05Z
rachel_sales: Sent the toggle info to Nimbus.
Nimbus-admin (via email): After retry they get 403 Forbidden on POST /scim/v2/Users.
oli_se: 403 usually means token scope or token-to-tenant mapping mismatch. Which credential are they using?
ben_infra: Looks like they used the Dedicated runtime pool key (inference) not the control-plane SCIM key. I'll generate a short-lived control-plane token and share a secure link.
deploy-bot: token created: tenant=nimbus-poc-9 scopes=[scim:read,scim:write] expires=2026-03-21T19:12:00Z 2 secure link created
rachel_sales: Sent token link to Nimbus via secure channel.
Nimbus-admin (email): Now 401 Unauthorized with the new token.
oli_se: 401 = wrong endpoint, missing tenant header, or token for different tenant. If they hit `https://nimbus-poc-9-control.redwood.private` they need VPC access.
ben_infra: Also if they hit the shared host `api.redwood.ai` they must include header `X-Redwood-Tenant: nimbus-poc-9`. I'll share an example curl.
ben_infra: Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: nimbus-poc-9" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" \
  -d '{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"userName":"lee@nimbus.com","name":{"givenName":"Lee","familyName":"Ng"},"emails":[{"value":"lee@nimbus.com","type":"work"}]}'
```
rachel_sales: Forwarded to Nimbus infra team.
Nimbus-admin: Okta side shows `SAML assertion missing group attribute` when users try to SSO.
mai_sec: For SAML group mapping we accept `groups` or the OID `urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.5923.1.1.1`. If IdP uses `memberOf` we can add it to the fallback list.
ben_infra: I'll add `memberOf` fallback on tenant now.
deploy-bot: tenant=nimbus-poc-9 saml.attributeFallbacks updated: ["urn:oid:1.3.6.1.4.1.5923.1.1.1","groups","memberOf"] by ben_infra
oli_se: Note: if they want SCIM to create groups, we need scim.groupsEnabled=true and the token must include scim:groups scope.
ben_infra: Enabling group writes for POC.
deploy-bot: config update: tenant=nimbus-poc-9 key=scim.groupsEnabled old=false new=true by ben_infra
mai_sec: Quick security note for their questionnaire: SCIM requests are processed on the control plane; logs redact PII and tenant audit logging can be enabled. I'll DM the exact language.
rachel_sales: Thanks all. Action items: ben flip strict -> done, issue control-plane token -> done, add saml fallbacks -> done, enable scim groups -> done. I'll confirm after Nimbus retries. :thumbsup:
